summary: BioNTech SE filed a 6-K announcing the commencement of a share buyback program for its ADSs on the Nasdaq Global Select Market. The program, authorized on May 7, 2026, allows repurchases of up to $1.0 billion through May 6, 2027, under existing AGM authorization for up to 24.9 million shares (10% of share capital). Repurchases are subject to price limits (within 10% above/20% below 3-day VWAP) and comply with EU MAR, Rule 10b-18, and 10b5-1. A mandated credit institution makes independent trading decisions. The buyback aims to satisfy ordinary course obligations and enhance capital efficiency. Watch for actual repurchase pace and impact on share price.
